expertise.label: ABOUT US
expertise.title: Our Expertise
paragraphs: We are a producer of high-quality edible oils with a strong focus on sunflower oil and carefully selected raw materials. Our production process is built on consistency, quality control, and respect for natural ingredients.
From seed selection to final bottling, every step is carefully monitored to ensure purity, stability, and reliable performance in everyday cooking and professional use.
Our goal is simple — to deliver oils that meet high quality standards and earn long-term trust.
We are the only oil factory in Macedonia that has applied the IFS certificate.

privateLabelSolutions.label: Private Label Solutions
privateLabelSolutions.subtitle: Your Brand. Our Expertise.
paragraphs: We offer comprehensive private label solutions for partners looking to develop or expand their edible oil portfolio under their own brand.
With modern production facilities, advanced quality control, and flexible packaging capabilities, we ensure reliable and high-quality products tailored to your market needs.

hero.label: BISER OIL
hero.title:
Decades of Trust in
Every Drop
paragraphs: The well-known brand that dates back more than 27 years on the domestic market and beyond – 100% sunflower edible oil "BISER" maintains the high quality and the well-deserved trust of its consumers. From 2023 became part of the Oil Refinery company "OSTROG-LUNA" – Strumica – North Macedonia.
"BISER" is a high-quality, 100% natural, and refined edible sunflower oil used for cooking, frying, and baking. Also, it can be used for preparing salads, dressings, and mayonnaise.
It is rich with vitamin E and polyunsaturated fatty acids. It contains the natural characteristics of the sunflower seeds from which it is produced.

guarantee.title: A Guarantee of Quality and Trust
paragraphs: The oil is refined to the highest quality to ensure a healthy and balanced diet because it is a daily used food in the household.

The edible sunflower oil "BISER" is produced in the technologically most modern factory. The team of high-quality engineers and technicians, the advanced technology controlled according to IFS standards and the long-standing epithet "oil number 1 in North Macedonia" are a guarantee for the high quality of "BISER" sunflower oil.

items.containers: ISO-certified 20ft and 40ft tank containers provide secure and efficient bulk transport of edible oil. Designed specifically for food-grade liquids, they ensure safe and reliable delivery across regional and international routes.
items.storage: High-quality stainless steel storage tanks ensure safe and hygienic preservation of edible oil. Temperature-controlled and food-grade certified, they maintain product quality at every stage.
items.vessel: Specialized tanker vessels allow large-scale international delivery of edible oil under strict quality and safety standards.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: This page explains how ostrogluna.com handles cookies and similar technologies. The short version: we do not use tracking cookies, advertising cookies or third-party marketing pixels. We do not display a cookie consent banner because none of the technologies we use require consent under the ePrivacy Directive or the GDPR.

noTrackingCookies.title: No Tracking or Advertising Cookies
noTrackingCookies.content: We do not run Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, advertising networks, retargeting tags or third-party marketing trackers on this website. We do not sell or share visitor data with advertisers.

essentialStorage.title: Strictly Necessary Technical Storage
essentialStorage.content: The Site may rely on a small amount of strictly necessary technical storage that is required for the page to function correctly (for example, remembering your selected language between pages or standard framework cookies set by our hosting provider for security). Strictly necessary storage of this type is exempt from the consent requirement under the ePrivacy Directive.

analyticsWithoutCookies.title: Cookieless Analytics (Vercel)
analyticsWithoutCookies.content: We use Vercel Web Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights, provided by Vercel Inc., to understand aggregate traffic and to monitor the technical performance of the Site. These services are designed to be privacy-friendly: they do not set tracking cookies, do not use cross-site identifiers, and do not build personal profiles of visitors. They process technical signals such as the page being viewed, anonymised IP-derived approximate location, device type, browser, referrer and basic performance timings, in order to generate aggregated, non-identifying statistics. For details, see Vercel's documentation on Web Analytics and Speed Insights.

searchConsole.title: Google Search Console
searchConsole.content: We use Google Search Console as an off-site webmaster tool to monitor how the Site appears in Google Search results (impressions, clicks, indexing status). Google Search Console does not place any tracking script or cookie on this website. The data it shows us is aggregated and provided by Google based on its own search index.

browserControls.title: Your Browser Controls
browserControls.content: You can always block or delete cookies and local storage through your browser settings. Because we do not rely on tracking cookies, doing so will not impair your ability to read the Site.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy & Data Protection Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we process when you visit ostrogluna.com or contact us, why we process it, how long we keep it, who we share it with, and the rights you have. We process personal data in line with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Law on Personal Data Protection of the Republic of North Macedonia.

dataController.title: Who We Are (Data Controller)
content: The data controller responsible for your personal data is:
OSTROG-LUNA DOO Strumica, registered office: Atanas Mucev no.2, 2400 Strumica, Republic of North Macedonia. Company registration number: 7633521. Tax ID: 4027022536770.
For any privacy-related question or to exercise your rights, contact us at info@ostrogluna.com.

dataWeCollect.title: What Data We Collect
content: Contact form data: when you submit our contact form, we receive the name and email address you provide (required), and your phone number and message (optional). We also record whether you ticked the consent checkbox for telephone contact.
Email correspondence: if you write to us directly, we receive your email address, your message and any information you choose to include.

Technical and usage data: when you visit the Site, our hosting provider and analytics providers process limited technical signals such as the requested URL, referrer, approximate location derived from IP, device type, browser, language and basic performance timings. These signals are used to generate aggregated, non-identifying statistics and are not combined with your contact details to build a profile of you.
We do not knowingly collect special categories of personal data through the Site, and we do not run advertising or behavioural tracking.

lawfulBasis.title: Lawful Basis for Processing
content: Contact form and direct correspondence: processed on the basis of your request to be contacted (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR — steps taken at your request prior to entering a contract) and, where you tick the consent box for telephone contact, on the basis of your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).

Aggregated, cookieless website analytics and performance monitoring: processed on the basis of our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) in understanding aggregate traffic and keeping the Site secure, fast and functional. Because the analytics tools we use do not set cookies or build personal profiles, the impact on your privacy is minimal.
Compliance with legal obligations: where applicable, we may process data to comply with legal obligations to which we are subject (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Data
content: To respond to enquiries you submit through the contact form or by email.
To follow up on commercial discussions, offers and orders that you initiate.
To monitor the Site's traffic and technical performance in aggregate, and to investigate security incidents.
To meet our legal, accounting and regulatory obligations.

processors.title: Service Providers and Recipients
content: We do not sell personal data. We share it only with the service providers that help us operate the Site and our communications, and only to the extent necessary:
Vercel Inc. — hosting of the website and provider of Vercel Web Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights (cookieless, aggregated analytics and performance monitoring).
Resend (Resend.com, Inc.) — transactional email delivery for messages sent through the contact form to our internal inbox.
Google Search Console — off-site webmaster tool that shows us aggregated search-performance data from Google's index. It does not place any script or cookie on the Site.
We may also disclose personal data to competent authorities where required to do so by law.

transfers.title: International Transfers
transfers.content: Some of our service providers (such as Vercel and Resend) are based outside North Macedonia and the European Economic Area, or process data in data centres located outside those territories. Where personal data is transferred internationally, we rely on appropriate safeguards under the GDPR, such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses and the providers' own technical and organisational measures. If you would like more information on the safeguards in place, please contact us at info@ostrogluna.com.

retention.title: How Long We Keep Your Data
content: Contact form submissions and related correspondence: kept for as long as needed to handle your enquiry and any resulting business relationship, and afterwards for a reasonable period for evidentiary and accounting purposes (typically up to 24 months from the last meaningful contact, unless a longer period is required by law).
Server and security logs: kept for short technical periods (typically up to 30 days) and only for as long as needed to operate and secure the Site.
Aggregated analytics statistics: retained without identifying individual visitors.
When we no longer need personal data, we delete or anonymise it.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
content: Subject to the conditions set out in the GDPR and the North Macedonia Law on Personal Data Protection, you have the right to:
access the personal data we hold about you and obtain a copy;
request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data;
request erasure of your data where one of the legal grounds for erasure applies;
request restriction of processing, or object to processing carried out on the basis of legitimate interest;
withdraw any consent you have given, at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out beforehand;
request data portability, where applicable;
lodge a complaint with the competent data protection supervisory authority if you believe our processing of your personal data is not in line with applicable law.

exerciseRights.title: How to Exercise Your Rights
exerciseRights.content: To exercise any of the rights above, please write to info@ostrogluna.com. We may need to verify your identity before acting on your request. We will respond within the time frame required by applicable law (generally one month, with the possibility of extension for complex requests).

children.title: Children
children.content: The Site is intended for a business audience and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

security.title: Security
security.content: We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure or access. No method of transmission over the internet, however, can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes to the Site, our practices or applicable law. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page indicates when the most recent revision was made. We encourage you to review this page periodically.

whistleblowerPolicy.title: Whistleblowing & Integrity Policy
whistleblowerPolicy.intro: Ostrog Luna is committed to high standards of transparency, integrity and ethical conduct. In line with the legislation of the Republic of North Macedonia on the protection of whistleblowers and the EU Whistleblower Protection Directive (2019/1937), we provide a secure channel for employees, contractors, suppliers and partners to report suspected wrongdoing in good faith.

scope.title: What Can Be Reported
scope.content: You can use this channel to report concerns about suspected violations of law, fraud, corruption, misuse of funds, serious health, safety or environmental risks, breaches of food-safety obligations, or other serious misconduct connected to our activities.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality
confidentiality.content: All reports are handled with strict confidentiality. The identity of the reporting person, and the identity of any third party mentioned in the report, will not be disclosed beyond the persons authorised to receive and follow up on the report, except where disclosure is required by law in the context of investigations or judicial proceedings.

noRetaliation.title: No Retaliation
noRetaliation.content: We strictly prohibit any form of retaliation, discrimination, demotion, dismissal, harassment or other adverse treatment against any person who reports a concern in good faith, or who assists with an investigation.

reportingChannel.title: How to Report
reportingChannel.content: Reports may be submitted in writing to our Compliance Officer at:
